title: Tofu Ramen Tacos
description: A fusion twist on traditional ramen, featuring crispy tofu and served in a taco shell.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.amount: 1 block, drained and cut into small pieces

ingredients.name: Aromatic oil
ingredients.notes: such as sesame or peanut oil

instructions: Heat the aromatic oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the broken ramen pieces and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the tofu pieces to the skillet and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Japanese soy sauce and Shio.
Add the soy sauce mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the tofu and ramen are well coated.
Warm the taco shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the tofu and ramen mixture into the shells.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with lime wedges.
